Facts:
- The Sierra Leone Civil War began on 23 March 1991 in Sierra Leone.
- The Revolutionary United Front intervened in Sierra Leone with support from the special forces of Charles Taylor’s National Patriotic Front of Liberia to overthrow the Joseph Momoh government.
- The Sierra Leone Civil War lasted from 1991 to 2002, continued for 11 years, enveloped Sierra Leone, and left over 50,000 dead.
- The Civil Defence Forces was a paramilitary organization that fought in the Sierra Leone Civil War.
- Much of the Civil Defence Forces was made up of the Kamajors group, which is part of the larger Mende ethnic group.
